behavior: AC1: darwin plan lists only outdated catalog formulae/casks; refresh is info
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test -count=1 -v -run 'TestSystemUpgrade.*Darwin.*Plan' ./internal/converge/) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSystemUpgrade'

behavior: AC2: darwin apply upgrades, cleans up, and a second run is changed=0
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test -count=1 -v -run 'TestSystemUpgrade.*Darwin.*Apply' ./internal/converge/) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSystemUpgrade'

behavior: AC3: a formula outside the catalog is never upgraded
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test -count=1 -v -run 'TestSystemUpgrade.*OutsideCatalog' ./internal/converge/) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSystemUpgrade'

behavior: AC4: linux skips without non-interactive sudo and upgrades only catalog packages with it
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test -count=1 -v -run 'TestSystemUpgrade.*Linux' ./internal/converge/) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSystemUpgrade'

behavior: AC5: windows upgrades per id and isolates one failure
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test -count=1 -v -run 'TestSystemUpgrade.*Windows' ./internal/converge/) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSystemUpgrade'

behavior: AC6: a failed refresh is a skip, not a failure
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test -count=1 -v -run 'TestSystemUpgrade.*Refresh' ./internal/converge/) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSystemUpgrade'

behavior: AC7: packages.json and ADR-036 state the upgrade rule
verification: ! grep -q 'it is never upgraded' packages.json && grep -q 'keeps it current (TOOL-036' packages.json && grep -q 'An unpinned system entry is kept current; a pinned entry still moves only by PR' docs/adr/adr-036-install-channels.md

behavior: AC8: dotf update runs system-upgrade on a day HEAD did not move, once, and fails with upgrade-failed when it fails
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test -count=1 -v -run 'TestRunUpgradesSystemPackagesOnAQuietDay' ./internal/update/) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestRunUpgradesSystemPackagesOnAQuietDay'
